title: Pin and checksum-verify the mcp-publisher binary in mcp-publish.yml
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/.github/workflows/mcp-publish.yml, replace the 'Install MCP Publisher' step (lines 20-22). Today it runs curl -L .../releases/latest/download/mcp-publisher_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz | tar xz. The new step: (a) pins an explicit release tag (env MCP_PUBLISHER_VERSION) instead of latest/download; (b) downloads the tarball to a file instead of piping it into tar; (c) checks the file against a sha256 committed in the workflow (env MCP_PUBLISHER_SHA256_LINUX_AMD64 and _ARM64, taken from the release's published checksums file and confirmed by one person downloading it separately), using echo "$SHA  file" | sha256sum -c -, and exits non-zero before tar or any ./mcp-publisher call if the check fails; (d) uses curl -fsSL so HTTP errors fail the step. Where the release publishes cosign or GitHub artifact attestations, also run gh attestation verify or cosign verify-blob and record which was used. Keep permissions id-token: write limited to this job. Do not test with workflow_dispatch of mcp-publish.yml on main, because that publishes to the registry. Test the install step on a feature branch with the Login and Publish steps removed, or run the step script locally. Merge through the normal PR process (1 approval, releaseProcess.approvalsRequired) and outside any release in progress.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -n 'releases/latest' .github/workflows/mcp-publish.yml returns no match, and the download URL contains a literal pinned version tag
The install step contains a sha256sum -c (or cosign / gh attestation verify) command that runs before tar extraction and before ./mcp-publisher is executed
A feature-branch run with a deliberately wrong sha256 fails at the verify step and never extracts or executes mcp-publisher; a run with the correct sha256 passes
probe-cicd-env on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server no longer emits CICD-PIN-03 for .github/workflows/mcp-publish.yml (fingerprint 454afe95e14049bfd1a5ae7a9be94a2c724c1e2cb7b8661307bdb1187c0cd007)

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-cicd-env for app mcp-gateway, repo mongodb-mcp-server after the PR merges and the checkout is refreshed. Expected: no CICD-PIN-03 result for .github/workflows/mcp-publish.yml, and an observation for sebi-cscrf-2024:PR.IP.S4 showing the download is pinned and checksum-verified.

rootCause.description: The publish workflow was copied from the MCP registry quick-start, which installs mcp-publisher from releases/latest through curl | tar with no integrity check. That lets a tampered upstream release run with the job's OIDC publish identity.
